name: bug-hunt
description: A bug nobody can see. Split hypotheses, not work: each model gets one hypothesis and the same repro via council_compare; Claude picks and implements the fix.

tasks.slice: minimal repro + 3 hypotheses written as testable statements
council_compare: same repro to 2-3 models, each confirms or refutes its hypothesis and proposes a fix WITHOUT implementing
only if the repro needs company data (local-only)
Claude implements the chosen fix (bug fixes are small and entangled) + regression test

notes: Do not dispatch implement cards for the fix itself.
